verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single what's-new mention: users can build agents via chat or a visual builder that 'run proactively based on triggers you set.' That points to self-running workflows, but it never says time-based or recurring schedules are among those triggers, nor that this belongs to Superhuman Mail rather than the broader Superhuman platform. Missing for 10: explicit time-based/recurring schedule triggers (e.g. cron-style or daily/weekly jobs), documentation of how scheduled workflows are configured and managed, confirmation the feature applies to Superhuman Mail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
